Three-year Indian B.Sc. and B.A. programmes usually cover cognitive, developmental, social, clinical and counselling psychology, research methods and statistics, with practical assessment work and observation postings, and lead to postgraduate study in clinical, counselling or organisational psychology.

courses.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
courses.summary: The Bachelor of Business Administration is an undergraduate management degree taken after secondary school. Core study covers accounting, finance, marketing, organisational behaviour, human resource management, operations, business law and economics, usually followed by a specialisation such as business analytics, international business, digital marketing, finance or healthcare management, plus an internship or live project. Programmes run for three years in many systems and four years where an honours or research year is added. Graduates move into entry-level management roles or continue to an MBA or a specialist master's degree.

Typical coursework covers programming languages, data structures, database systems, operating systems, computer networks, web and mobile development, software engineering and discrete mathematics, with electives in areas such as data science, cyber security or cloud computing. The degree usually lasts three years, or four with an honours or research year, and commonly leads to software and IT roles or to a Master of Computer Applications.

universities.name: B. S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology
universities.summary: B. S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology is a private deemed-to-be university at Vandalur, Chennai. Its regular programmes span engineering, computing, business, sciences, commerce and the humanities, with separate schools for architecture, law and pharmacy. Admission routes and fees vary by programme and applicant category.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Vandalur campus has departmental academic blocks, laboratories, a computerized library, reading halls, seminar spaces and sports grounds. Separate residential hostels serve men and women. The programme entries here cover this main campus; the women-only Madurai campus has its own programme portfolio and joining arrangements.
universities.cityProfile: The main campus is at Seethakathi Estate on GST Road, Vandalur, Chennai 600048. UGC’s university register records deemed-to-be university notification on 16 December 2008. The former Crescent Engineering College identity and the newer Madurai campus must be distinguished when selecting a programme.
universities.practicalExposure: Engineering curricula combine theory, laboratory and project work and prescribe industrial visits from the second year. Postgraduate project work can take place in industry or a research organization with departmental approval and supervision. The MBA regulation includes a summer internship of at least eight weeks after semester two. B.Sc. Aviation covers aviation theory and operations; professional licensing has separate requirements.
universities.hostelOverview: KBA men’s and TBAK women’s hostels provide campus accommodation with Wi-Fi, reading and recreation rooms, gyms, laundry and RO drinking water. A cot, mattress, table and chair are supplied; students bring their bedding and personal items. International students have separate room and tariff arrangements. Request the current room, deposit and mess quotation before booking.
universities.dietarySupport: The hostel mess provides vegetarian and non-vegetarian dining options. The hostel facility lists halal-certified food provision and an FSSAI licence. Separate men’s and women’s messes serve residents; confirm allergies and other dietary requirements before choosing a meal plan.
universities.safetyOverview: A 24-hour health centre has eight inpatient beds, two resident doctors, paramedical staff and an ambulance. A specialist doctor visits the hostel weekly, and AG Hospital in Tambaram is the named emergency referral partner. Hostel facilities include CCTV and power backup.
universities.studentSupport: The Crescent Professional Counselling Centre and Centre for International Relations are named student-support services. Students can also use library, computing and residential facilities. Students Traffic can help review programme fit, academic documents and admission-category questions.

faq.question: Where is Crescent located?
faq.answer: The main campus is at Seethakathi Estate, GST Road, Vandalur, Chennai 600048. The separate Madurai campus is exclusively for women and has its own programme list and admission process.

faq.question: Is Crescent a deemed-to-be university?
faq.answer: UGC’s university register lists Crescent with notification dated 16 December 2008. Programme-specific permissions from AICTE, COA, PCI and BCI have separate scopes.

faq.question: Which programmes have NBA accreditation?
faq.answer: NBA’s register confirms undergraduate Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering and Information Technology through 31 December 2028. This accreditation does not extend automatically to other programmes or specialisations.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: The programmes listed here use English for teaching and assessment under their applicable regulations. Islamic Studies has separate language and cohort arrangements and remains outside this admissions scope.

faq.question: What marks are needed for B.Tech. admission?
faq.answer: The 2026 domestic route requires 50% in the specified higher-secondary subjects, regular formal schooling and the stated birth-date range. Selection combines CIEAT 2026 and school marks; candidates with a valid JEE Main score use the listed direct-selection route.

faq.question: Are overseas applicants assessed separately?
faq.answer: Yes. The separately listed NRI and foreign-national routes specify qualification equivalence, subjects, English requirements and relevant degree alternatives. Domestic tests and tuition do not apply automatically to overseas applicants.

faq.question: What is required for a master’s degree?
faq.answer: Each programme has a specific qualifying degree or subject background and minimum marks. Domestic M.Tech. and MCA selection uses CUAT 2026 with listed national-test exemptions. MBA entry uses accepted management entrance scores and the stated selection process. Read the overseas conditions separately.

faq.question: When did the verified first-year cohorts begin?
faq.answer: For 2026–27, B.Tech. commencement/student induction is 30 July; BCA, B.Sc. and B.A. is 3 August; B.Com. and BBA is 6 August; M.Tech., MCA, M.Sc. and M.Com. is 10 August. MBA, MBA IEV and MBA Real Estate Management also start 10 August. These dates do not establish a later-cycle application deadline.

faq.question: How are tuition fees shown?
faq.answer: Current 2026–27 domestic tuition is recorded in INR. Merit-based rates depend on the stated school marks, entrance score or CGPA; some commerce rates differ by shift. Verified NRI/foreign annual tuition is listed separately in USD, with one-time charges identified.

faq.question: Are accommodation and other charges included?
faq.answer: Tuition is separate from hostel, transport and other charges. Many programmes list a one-time amenities/service fee. Clinical Embryology and Stem Cell Technology domestic amounts are two-year totals with an explicitly calculated annual average. Request the full category-specific budget.

faq.question: What food and residential facilities are available?
faq.answer: Separate men’s and women’s hostels provide Wi-Fi, study and recreation spaces, gyms, laundry and RO water. Messes offer vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, with halal-certified provision listed by the hostel.

faq.question: What medical support is on campus?
faq.answer: The 24-hour health centre has two resident doctors, paramedical staff, eight inpatient beds and an ambulance. A specialist visits the hostel weekly; AG Hospital in Tambaram is the emergency referral partner.

fee.notes: Domestic 2026–27 tuition: INR 210,000 per year in the below-60% qualifying-marks band. evidence.claimText: B. S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science and Technology is a private deemed-to-be university at Vandalur, Chennai. Its regular programmes span engineering, computing, business, sciences, commerce and the humanities, with separate schools for architecture, law and pharmacy. Admission routes and fees vary by programme and applicant category.
evidence.sourceLabel: Current official programme/regulation or body-owned register

evidence.claimText: The main campus is at Seethakathi Estate on GST Road, Vandalur, Chennai 600048. UGC’s university register records deemed-to-be university notification on 16 December 2008. The former Crescent Engineering College identity and the newer Madurai campus must be distinguished when selecting a programme.
evidence.sourceLabel: Current official programme/regulation or body-owned register

evidence.claimText: The Vandalur campus has departmental academic blocks, laboratories, a computerized library, reading halls, seminar spaces and sports grounds. Separate residential hostels serve men and women. The programme entries here cover this main campus; the women-only Madurai campus has its own programme portfolio and joining arrangements.
evidence.sourceLabel: Current official programme/regulation or body-owned register

evidence.claimText: Engineering curricula combine theory, laboratory and project work and prescribe industrial visits from the second year. Postgraduate project work can take place in industry or a research organization with departmental approval and supervision. The MBA regulation includes a summer internship of at least eight weeks after semester two. B.Sc. Aviation covers aviation theory and operations; professional licensing has separate requirements.
evidence.sourceLabel: Current official programme/regulation or body-owned register

evidence.claimText: KBA men’s and TBAK women’s hostels provide campus accommodation with Wi-Fi, reading and recreation rooms, gyms, laundry and RO drinking water. A cot, mattress, table and chair are supplied; students bring their bedding and personal items. International students have separate room and tariff arrangements. Request the current room, deposit and mess quotation before booking.
evidence.sourceLabel: Current official programme/regulation or body-owned register

evidence.claimText: The hostel mess provides vegetarian and non-vegetarian dining options. The hostel facility lists halal-certified food provision and an FSSAI licence. Separate men’s and women’s messes serve residents; confirm allergies and other dietary requirements before choosing a meal plan.
evidence.sourceLabel: Current official programme/regulation or body-owned register

evidence.claimText: A 24-hour health centre has eight inpatient beds, two resident doctors, paramedical staff and an ambulance. A specialist doctor visits the hostel weekly, and AG Hospital in Tambaram is the named emergency referral partner. Hostel facilities include CCTV and power backup.
evidence.sourceLabel: Current official programme/regulation or body-owned register

evidence.claimText: The Crescent Professional Counselling Centre and Centre for International Relations are named student-support services. Students can also use library, computing and residential facilities. Students Traffic can help review programme fit, academic documents and admission-category questions.
evidence.sourceLabel: Current official programme/regulation or body-owned register

Eligibility
For NRI / Foreign National Candidates
Candidates should have completed 12 years of schooling (equivalent to 10+2 system of Indian education, CBSE, ISC etc.) with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics as subjects of study. The candidates should have minimum average of 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
English as one of the subjects of qualifying examination.
Candidates completed A Levels, IB, STPM, HSC, WASSCE, NCEA Level 3, American High School Diploma, etc. with minimum 50% aggregate or equivalent grade in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics and a pass in English.
Candidates studied under American High School system are eligible, if the above courses have been studied in the 11th and 12th grades or ‘AP’ (Advanced Placement) courses.
The date of birth should be between January 2004 and December 2009.
